media.caption: Read the 1794 treaty and the January 1795 ratification as distinct actions. Names and seals show documentary form, not proof that every promise was later kept. Onondaga explanations of speakers and wampum supply another kind of political knowledge. The faded handwriting is accompanied by cited transcriptions.
